en: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Deal Beach, Monmouth County, New Jersey, 1890, Sheet 59, part 2 (The Allen House, Main Avenue between Allen and Corlies Avenues)

sheet-59-2.description: This part is the upper left of four separate vignettes on sheet 59 of the 1890 New Jersey Coast Map, drawn at 50 feet to an inch with north to the right. It shows the grounds of The Allen House, a summer hotel at Deal Beach, in the block bounded by Main Avenue along the top (west), Allen Avenue on the left (south) and Corlies Avenue on the right (north). Main Avenue and Allen Avenue are marked 60 feet wide and Corlies Avenue 50 feet. The hotel is a long frame building of one, one and a half and two and a half stories set back from Main Avenue near Allen Avenue, with a one-story wing running north to a water closet. Behind it stand its outbuildings, lettered on the map: a small frame building, an octagonal ice house, a two-story wagon house with attached sheds, a two-story frame building near Corlies Avenue, and a row of one-story sleeping rooms with further sheds towards Allen Avenue. The rest of the block, towards the beach (east, at the bottom of the part), is open ground; no buildings or lot lines are drawn there and the part ends at a heavy dividing line. A north arrow is drawn in the block, and a note places the property about two miles north of the Asbury Park post office. The site is today in the Borough of Allenhurst, which was laid out on the Allen farm in the mid-1890s; the old Main Avenue drawn here follows the line of modern Norwood Avenue, including its bend at Corlies Avenue, rather than modern Main Street. Only the block and the three bounding streets are drawn; there is no detail outside them.
notes: Main Av. on this part is modern Norwood Avenue (bearing and bend at Corlies Avenue match); modern Main Street (NJ 71) lies about 500 m west.
The Allen House was a summer hotel; the Borough of Allenhurst was later laid out on the Allen farm.
Note on the map: About 2 Miles N. of Asbury Park P.O.

Single sheet (New Jersey Coast Map sheet 59), 50 ft to an inch, four separate vignettes of resort properties divided by heavy lines, each drawn with north to the right: part 1 (bottom left, largest) Deal Beach Cottages between Elberon Av. and Allen Av. down to the beach, Loch Arbor to the south; part 2 (top left) The Allen Ho. on Main Av. between Allen Av. and Corlies Av.; part 3 (top right) Hathaway Ho. on Main Av. with title cartouche, compass and key; part 4 (bottom right) Hendrickson's Cottages and Roseld Cottage on Rosolo Av. The 1890 Main Av. is modern Norwood Avenue (its bearing and its bend at Corlies match; modern Main Street does not); Rosolo Av. is Roseld Avenue. Only part 2 has street junctions.

Not georeferenced on this sheet: Deal Beach Cottages, Elberon Av. to Allen Av. at the beach (Allenhurst) (no street junction: Elberon and Allen Avs. are drawn only as two parallel streets running to the beach, with no cross street; lots predate the 1895 Allenhurst plat; needs a feature drawn on a placed sheet of this block (no other atlas here covers it), or the 1890 shoreline).

Not georeferenced on this sheet: Hathaway House on Main Av. (now Norwood Avenue), Deal (no street junction: only Main Av. is drawn; where along it the property lies is not shown; needs a junction or a building shared with a placed sheet of the same site).

Not georeferenced on this sheet: Hendrickson's Cottages and Roseld Cottage on Rosolo Av. (now Roseld Avenue), Deal (no street junction: only Rosolo Av. is drawn, with no cross street; Roseld Cottage is not on Deal 1907 sheet 2; needs a junction or a building shared with a placed sheet).
